steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each scenario and contact is matched to a role and a working number.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Spill scenario with no role
findings.fix: Assign the role that acts first

outcome.notChecked: Whether the staff know the plan; whether the contacts answer.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] scenario-spill.md:12  Spill scenario with no role.
       Fix: Assign the role that acts first.
[medium] contacts.md:19  Contact with no working number.
       Fix: Add the working number.
[low] drills.md:26  Drill past its planned interval.
       Fix: Schedule the next drill.
Not checked: Whether the staff know the plan; whether the contacts answer.
pros: Checks a scenario with no role, a contact with no working number or no role, and a drill date past the planned interval.
cons: Not checked: Whether the staff know the plan; whether the contacts answer.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-emergency-plan skill on the records for this review.
